correctness.rationale: With h(u)=u²+tu−1, h has no torus zero: subtracting the conjugate equation multiplied by u² forces u²=1, where h=±t≠0. The lift gives exactly one preimage x=y/h(u) per direction u mapping to v=y^(q−1), and F(0)=0. At v=±1 the remaining quadratics are u²+(t±2)u+1 with respective nonsquare discriminants 2(t±1)²; their conjugate inverse roots lie on the torus, and coincidence with the first root would force t=∓4, impossible since char≠2,3. For v≠±1 set ε=v−v⁻¹, A=ε²=s²−4 and τ=t+εU. Then τ is never zero, x=(y/τ)^q and u=v⁻¹τ^q/τ. Multiplying u−u⁻¹=εU by ττ^q yields AU³−AU²+(2−2ts)U+2=0, so the reduction is reversible. For this monic cubic the discriminant, after reduction by t²=−2, is −16(s+5t)²/A³. Since ε^q=−ε and ε≠0, A is nonsquare in F_q, as is −1. For s≠−5t the Frobenius permutation is even on three distinct roots, giving zero or three rational roots. At s=−5t the cubic is (U−1/3)³ with A=−54≠0. The two critical directions are exactly the roots of v²+5tv+1 with discriminant −54 and character χ_q(3); they belong to the torus iff this character is −1. Multiplying nonzero direction counts by q−1 and adding the singleton at zero yields S, and conservation of the q² inputs gives the two remaining counts. In an independent bounded computation enumerate the norm-one torus by (a+i)/(a−i) for a∈F_q, plus 1, i²=−1, and evaluate u h(u)^q/h(u) directly using conjugation. For q=11,19,1331, the respective direction histograms in multiplicity order (0,1,2,3) are (8,0,0,4), (12,2,0,6), (888,0,0,444), for both signs of t. For q=1331 the base field was represented by F_11[Z]/(Z³+Z+4), irreducible by checking all eleven residues. The singleton directions matched 2 Re(v)+5t=0 in all cases.
residual_risks: The frozen prime-only script was inspected, not executed. The independent bounded check includes a proper prime power but is not used to prove the all-prime-power result. Characteristic three and other q or coefficient regimes are outside the claim.

evidence: The exact earlier trinomial's cubic and discriminant are in Hou 2013. The April/May 2026 cubic classification places f_{−3,1} in Class III-c for q≠1 mod 6, with no F_q-rational ramification points, and in III-d for q≡1 mod 6, with ramification type (3/1,3/1). Class III excludes 2-fibers. The many-to-one paper's publisher text was unavailable; its abstract-level description is not needed for the verdict.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Class III membership alone does not exclude one rational point and a conjugate pair in an unramified fiber. Here the specific representative has two total ramification points and is the Rédei cube: if d²=−3 then (R(z)+d)/(R(z)−d)=((z+d)/(z−d))³. For d rational this acts on F_q^× away from 0,∞, and otherwise it acts on the norm-one group of order q+1. In each case the relevant group order is divisible by 3 (d rational iff q≡1 mod 3 by the cube-root-of-unity equation); its nonempty fibers have size 3. The two separate branch values give the only possible rational singletons, exactly as the prior ramification types prescribe.

evidence: Transfer the prior representative as above. In original direction coordinate u the derivative numerator of Φ is (u²−tu+1)², so its two geometric branch points have u+u⁻¹=t. At either, h(u)=2u² and Φ(u)=u⁻³, hence the branch value has v+v⁻¹=t³−3t=−5t. Its direction is rational on the torus exactly when the quadratic in v has nonsquare discriminant −54, with character χ_q(3). Counting gives 1+(q−1)(1−χ_q(3)) singletons including zero, then (q²−S)/3 triples and twice that many empty targets.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The extra localization is a direct translation of the two known ramification values, not an additional independent classification. The claimed exact value-set size and absence of all other multiplicities are routine corollaries of the specific known class and the scalar-fiber lift; the frozen proof by Hou's discriminant is an alternative derivation.

The last expression becomes −3λb R(z), R(z)=(z³−9z)/(3z²−3), since (t+4)/t=9λ. For z=2X−1, R(2X−1)+1=(2/3) f_{−3,1}(X). All substitutions are automorphisms of the projective lines in question, with nonzero denominators in the constants; the rational-map equality also covers poles.

originality.rationale: The exact trinomial and its cubic reduction already appear in Hou 2013, but the permutation criterion alone is not a multiplicity census. Decisively, the induced direction map is two-sided projectively equivalent over F_q to the already classified cubic f_{−3,1}(X)=(X³−3X+1)/(X(X−1)) in Hou–Peng–Qiang–Zhao, arXiv:2604.18954v2 (2026-05-19), §6.1 and §§6.3, 6.6–6.8. Their Class III and ramification classification supplies exactly the fiber alternatives. Translating its branch values back and counting the q−1 targets per direction gives the claimed histogram and singleton directions by substitution and elementary counting. This is positive prior-coverage evidence in an equivalent formulation, not an exact textual match or an inference from an inaccessible article.
residual_risks: The related many-to-one journal article and two indexed mirrors were not available in full. This does not affect the explicit comparison with the earlier preprint. No claim of textual identity, attribution of discovery, or global earliest priority is made.
